recommendation: Keep the commit. Do not restore the MPHO profile to FHIR Core unless OO/FMG reverse the later FHIR-52021/FHIR-54998 migration decision; profile maturation should continue in the OO Incubator IG.
issue_request: FHIR-43377 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification and requested an optional FHIR Core profile on BiologicallyDerivedProduct for medical products of human origin, with mandatory traceability elements, a fixed MPHO category value, and identifier guidance.
initial_application: The request was initially applied by d392376bf1 and merged by 95c734c3e0/PR #3198, which added StructureDefinition/MedicalProductOfHumanOrigin and related BDP profile pages. Subsequent source commits adjusted casing, cardinalities, profile warnings, and biologicalSourceEvent wording.
additional_context: Later OO decisions FHIR-52021 and FHIR-54998 concluded the MPHO profile was not ready for R6 normative core and should move to the OO Incubator IG. Commit 6bf92471f8 removed the profile, profile examples, and core IG reference from FHIR Core. The OO Incubator continuous build and source now carry the medicalproductofhumanorigin profile.
reconciliation: Changed source/biologically-derived-product-module.html so the MPHO traceability sentence links to https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/oo-incubator/StructureDefinition-medicalproductofhumanorigin.html and says the profile is under development in the OO Incubator IG. This preserves the seed's traceability guidance while reflecting the later removal from core.
source_changes: source/biologically-derived-product-module.html:45 now links the MPHO profile reference to the OO Incubator StructureDefinition and marks it under development there.
